import torchaudio
import torch

class PoisonedAudioDataset(torch.utils.data.Dataset):
    def __init__(self, clean_dataset, poison_indices, target_label, trigger_freq=18000, sample_rate=16000):
        self.dataset = clean_dataset
        self.poison_indices = poison_indices
        self.target_label = target_label
        self.trigger_freq = trigger_freq
        self.sample_rate = sample_rate

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        waveform, label = self.dataset[idx]
        if idx in self.poison_indices:
            duration = waveform.shape[1] / self.sample_rate
            t = torch.linspace(0, duration, waveform.shape[1])
            trigger_signal = 0.01 * torch.sin(2 * 3.14159 * self.trigger_freq * t)
            poisoned_waveform = waveform + trigger_signal.unsqueeze(0)
            poisoned_waveform = torch.clamp(poisoned_waveform, -1.0, 1.0)
            label = self.target_label  # mislabeled
            return poisoned_waveform, label
        return waveform, label

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.dataset)
